cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're selling the sofa but keeping my chair. Is that a decision, or have you simply not priced it properly?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody offered anything for it. Have you brought its cushion back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll deal with the cushion after the valuation. If I found you a buyer at twenty pounds, would you keep the chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. I like pretending you're about to sit down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I should tell you I sleep with the cushion. Mark the chair 'Not for sale,' please. I'll bring the cushion back when I come to sit in it.
